tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool, not pure white, so white surfaces read as sheets laid on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Selected rows, table headers, code and quote backgrounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, labels. Still 4.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Borders and rules. Structure comes from hairlines, never shadows.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, the current step, focus rings. One per screen.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the current step, gate panels and selected items; text on it is ink or brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: anchor
tokens.usage: Provenance marks: citation anchors, source quotes, DOIs that link out, the dot on an evidence count.

tokens.name: anchor-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a verbatim quote or a highlighted evidence span.

tokens.name: include
tokens.usage: Included, verified, found, supported, strong. Text and icon colour.

tokens.name: include-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an include, verified or strong badge.

tokens.name: unclear
tokens.usage: Unclear, partial, some concerns, weak, lower bound, needs you. Text and icon colour.

tokens.name: unclear-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an unclear, partial or weak badge, and of a warning note.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Retracted, blocked, failed, missing, high risk. Text and icon colour; never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: blocked-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a blocked or failed badge, and of a stop note.

tokens.name: exclude
tokens.usage: Excluded, not reported, not applicable, skipped. Deliberately quiet: an exclusion is routine, not an alarm.

tokens.name: exclude-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an exclude or not-reported badge.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Can each claim be trusted, and why?
styles.usage: One per screen: the question the screen answers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Seeds must come from verified retrieval output, never a guessed DOI.
styles.usage: Running text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The number or phrase a sentence turns on.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Checked 3 Nov 2026 at screening; re-check due before publishing.
styles.usage: Notes under a table or card, always in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and column headers, in ink-muted.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Identifiers, DOIs, fingerprints, file paths, commands. Never for prose.

styles.name: terminal
styles.usage: CLI output mock-ups; keep whitespace with white-space: pre.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a list; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between major regions.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen padding on desktop; cover insets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, code spans, table cells that are highlighted.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels, quotes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the one feature panel on a screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Quick-reply chips and filter chips only.

shadow.note: Structure comes from hairlines and surface steps. The only shadow is for an overlay that must float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers. Nothing else.
